beats.story: Randal, Cliff, and I round the corner. My eyes dart across the office -- everything in the space seems ornamental, surreal, like it's from a dream. A whole room of muffled voices falls silent as we approach. Some stare directly at us. Some refuse to turn away from their screens, like I don't exist. In a way, I no longer do. Heat crawls up my neck as we pass the watercooler, our footsteps in time with its incessant dripping. A dizzying pulse rushes through my head.
beats.story_cn: 兰德尔、克里夫和我转过墙角。我的目光迅速扫过整个办公室——这里的一切都华而不实，虚幻得不真实，仿佛置身梦境。我们走近时，满屋子压低的嗓音骤然沉寂。有人直勾勾地盯着我们，有人固执地盯着屏幕不肯转头，仿佛我根本不存在。某种意义上，我确实已不复存在。经过饮水机时，热意顺着我的脖子往上爬，脚步声与持续不断的滴水声诡异地同频。一阵眩晕的悸动冲上我的头顶。

beats.story: I might faint in the middle of the floor, in front of everyone. And it wouldn't even matter. I flash back to my first walk of shame. I fought so hard. Broke everything. I lock eyes with Rhonda as she shuffles through her desk. Her expression crumbles at the sight of me. She knows.
beats.story_cn: 我可能会在办公室中央晕倒，在所有人面前。而那甚至无关紧要。画面闪回我第一次狼狈离场的场景。我曾那般拼命抗争，毁掉了一切。我的视线撞上正在翻找文件的罗达，她看见我的瞬间表情骤然崩塌。她知道了。

I'll never see Armin water it with Gatorade again. I'll never suffer Rhonda's Christmas decorations. These are just facts, just words.
beats.story_cn: 不知怎的，她竟察觉了。我后退半步，目光落在乔伊身上。所有强压的怒火瞬间泄气，空虚取而代之。我飞速眨了几下眼睛。我再也看不到阿尔文用佳得乐浇灌它了。我再也忍受不了罗达的圣诞装饰了。这些只是事实，只是词句罢了。

beats.story: Just the truth. I stare at the faces around me. I've made them hurt. My throat is like a vise holding back the sobs that won't come. After all of it -- these people were never nothing. This is my whole life, right now. "Armin's killing your plant," I say to Rhonda. "Actually, I don't know if you remember, but it was my plant first." Rhonda's head shakes.

The three pushpins stay in place. Cliff mutters behind me, "You can go through your drawers and take any material that wasn't confiscated." I shake my head. "Irrelevant now. You can toss it." I step away and my gaze snags on the chair stain.
beats.story_cn: 她下颌的赘肉随着她把乔伊搂近而颤动，如母兽护崽般充满保护欲。一如她始终的姿态。但他们也伤害了我。我踉跄着回到自己的工位，抓起迈莉的斑马摆件。三根图钉依然牢牢钉着。克里夫在我身后咕哝：“你可以翻翻抽屉，把那些没被没收的资料拿走。”我摇摇头。“现在无关紧要了。你可以扔掉。”我转身走开，目光却钉在那处椅面污渍上。

beats.story: I choke up when the realization hits. The wrong I did is too vast, too much. I have nothing left here. As I'm turning around, Armin exits the bathroom, headphones around his neck. He rushes toward me, not even noticing the procession flanking me. "Jolene, my mom just call -- " "It's over, Armin." "The party's off?" His brow creases. "Thanks. It's for the be -- " "It's all over." And I step away, leaving him staring after me.
beats.story_cn: 当领悟如潮水涌来时，我哽住了。我犯下的错太深重，太多。我在这里已一无所有。正要转身时，阿明从洗手间出来了，耳机挂在脖子上。他朝我冲过来，甚至没注意到簇拥着我的那一行人。“佐伊，我妈刚打电话——” “结束了，阿明。” “派对取消了？”他眉头紧锁。“谢啦，本来是要庆——” “一切都结束了。” 我抽身离开，留他在身后怔怔望着。

beats.story: Cliff and Randal walk me to the elevator bank. As we wait for it to arrive, Cliff squares his shoulders. "You accomplished at least one goal on your list. You nailed it." My stomach curdles. "It's not a Monday, Cliff. What are the stats on letting someone like me go today?" "I don't know. I've never fired someone like you." His voice is hollow, distant. Hurt.
beats.story_cn: 克利夫和兰德尔送我到电梯间。等电梯时，克利夫挺直肩背：“你至少完成了清单上的一项，干得漂亮。”我的胃猛地一沉。“今天不是周一，克利夫。像我这样的人今天被炒的概率是多少？”“不知道，我从没开除过你这样的人。”他的声音空荡而遥远，透着痛楚。

In the elevator, Randal stares at the floor. I say goodbye to him in the lobby, even though our relationship was, of course, parasocial. I'm not sure he even knew my name before today. I step out of the building for the last time.
beats.story_cn: 他的目光终于从我身上移开，电梯门应声而开。我和兰德尔踏入轿厢。克利夫转身离去，连电梯门关闭都未等。电梯里，兰德尔盯着地板。我在大厅同他道别，尽管我们不过是点头之交。或许今日之前，他连我名字都不知道。我最后一次踏出这座大楼。

beats.story: The wind tickles my cheeks. It's a sunny day. And I am jobless, with no prospects. I promptly make work of getting completely destroyed. My plan involves liquor. I stop at the store and buy as much as I can carry. I won't have enough for next month's rent anyway. When I make it back to my building, Miley's seated on the bench in the communal area. "You're home early," she says, eyes floating from the bags of booze dangling from my arms to her zebra, clenched in my grip. "What's going on?" I push past her without saying a word.
beats.story_cn: 风轻挠我的脸颊，晴空万里。我却失业了，前路无光。我当即决定用酒精将自己彻底摧毁。计划从烈酒开始。我拐进商店，能搬多少就买多少——反正下月房租也凑不齐了。回到公寓楼时，米莉正坐在公共区域的长椅上。“回来得真早啊。”她目光掠过我臂弯摇晃的酒袋，落在我紧攥的斑马玩偶上，“出什么事了？”我一言不发地从她身边挤过。
